market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: The market implies a 1.1% chance that CL settles at or below $40 by end of June 2026. Historically, similar magnitude drops (~45%) from mid-$70s occurred multiple times in the past 15 years (e.g., 2014–2016, 2020) driven by recessions, supply gluts, or demand shocks. While current conditions don't feature a clear catalyst, tail risks (global recession, OPEC+ breakdown, financial crisis) give a moderate 3–5% probability, making the market underpriced.
evidence_points: Crude oil dropped below $40 in 2015–2016 and briefly in 2020, demonstrating feasibility of such moves.
Recessionary or geopolitical shocks can trigger sharp oil demand or supply imbalances within 18 months.
OPEC+ unwinding cuts in 2025–2026 could add supply pressure, coinciding with fragile economic sentiment.
sources_consulted: Historical WTI settlement price charts (Macrotrends, FRED)
